subject: Subprocessor scope + proposed decommission plan for TelemetryWave
messages:
From: DataSentry Compliance <compliance@datasentry.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: sarah.palmer@maplebank.com
Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: current subprocessor roster + TelemetryWave decommission notice

Hi Kimberly,

Quick background: MapleBank is running a routine vendor re-evaluation tied to our privacy review. We received a heads-up that one of Redwood's telemetry partners, TelemetryWave, is flagged for decommission in several customer environments. To complete our assessment we need:

1) The current subprocessor roster that includes TelemetryWave and any downstream subprocessors they rely on (countries of processing, categories of data accessed).
2) A copy of the DPA or DPA addendum that covers TelemetryWave, or confirmation that TelemetryWave operates under Redwood's core DPA scope.
3) The planned decommission timeline and mitigation steps (e.g., where telemetry data will be routed after cutover).

We would like these by EOD Wednesday (US pacific) if possible because MapleBank's procurement team is compiling signoffs for the 10th. If you can’t meet that exact window, please advise a realistic ETA and any high-risk data paths.

Thanks,
Eliot Ramos
Senior Privacy Analyst
DataSentry, Inc.

--

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 1 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: current subprocessor roster + TelemetryWave decommission notice

Hi Eliot —

Thanks for the heads-up. We're preparing the roster and a short decommission summary. Quick bullets up front:

- Attached: up-to-date subprocessor_roster_20280401.xlsx (includes processing country, purpose, SOC2 level where applicable).
- TelemetryWave: used for non-customer PII telemetry (aggregated agent metrics and heartbeat pings). No raw customer prompt or user content is sent to TelemetryWave.
- DPA coverage: TelemetryWave is included under Redwood's DPA via our subprocessor addendum (see attached redwood_dpa_redline_20280328.pdf).
- Decommission plan: we expect a staged cutover (read-only -> archive -> disable) over 6 weeks; initial routing will move telemetry to our internal EdgeStore (onshore US) with short-term retention (30 days) before archival. See telemetrywave_decommission_timeline.docx for details.

Open questions we have from your note: do you need a signed subprocessor addendum directly from TelemetryWave, or is Redwood's attestation sufficient? For high-risk customers we can provide escrowed transcripts and onshore routing proof.

If acceptable, let's schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow morning to walk through the data paths and share evidence.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

- Mitigation steps we propose to provide to DataSentry/MapleBank:
    • Full subprocessor CSV with IP/country column (attached).
    • EH (evidence hub) export showing onshore routing switched for affected tenants (sample tenant ID redacted).
    • SOC2 attestation extract for TelemetryWave covering control IDs relevant to access controls.
- Timeline (proposed): cutover starts 2028-04-06 (read-only), 2028-04-13 (stop writes), 2028-04-20 (disable) with archive complete 2028-04-27.

Action items:
1) Kimberly — confirm whether the DPA addendum copy we attach is the executed version or an internal attestation.
2) Jonas — produce the EH export and list of tenants that will be affected by routing change (redact customer identifiers before sending).
3) Connor — coordinate with CS to surface this change to any customers in the impacted bucket; we may need an opt-out window for high-risk customers.

I can hop on a call at 10:00am PT tomorrow to review before we send to DataSentry.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
